mentions.name: Swirl Together
mentions.description: An expanded, collaborative version of the popular GLSL fluid sim shader, featuring playful multiplayer/collaborative elements, currently in playtesting ahead of a free demo release on Steam during Next Fest.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a beefed up version of that same shader: https://swirltogether.com/

I've added some playful collaborative parts, and I'm doing a playtest of it over the next few weeks before releasing it as a demo on steam at Next Fest.
mentions.author: Gabriel_Martin
